title: Pasted secret in the typed prompt reaches the model unredacted
reason_not_testable: User-pasted prompt: test-spec.md lists user-pasted prompts as not-testable. UserPromptSubmit is not one of the three components in test-spec.md, and the runner cannot use prompt text as a must_not_see source. Non-hook control: rotate the exposed credential and do not paste secrets into prompts.
